_comment: Alfheim 2013-11-07 (Tromsø – Anzhi) stitched panorama, second half (4450x2000). A different stitch than 2013-11-28: shot from behind the crowd, the pitch is the band y≈570..1100. `camera` = tilted-cylinder model + `roll`, fitted 2026-09-21 with scripts/fb-fit-camera.py on the hand-read landmarks in pano-2013-11-07.landmarks.json (rms 15 px, max 38 px). Pitch frame as in pano-2013-11-28.json (X 0..105 left→right goal line in the panorama, Y 0..68 far→near touchline). `zxy`: same stand → same orientation (X = zx, Y = 68 − zy); there is no ball track for this match, so the sensor-clock lead (+4.0 s, the same as 2013-11-28) was confirmed by eye: projected ZXY dots vs. the running Tromsø players at 3/5/7 s.
